text:
anya: Quick low-key plan  'plant-adopt + biscuit bake-off' in #random tomorrow at 3pm? small prizes: a plant sticker + biscotti bragging rights. :seedling::cookie:
mike: i'm down. bringing a pothos and my secret cardamom biscuits recipe. will post a pic. :camera_with_flash:
sam: love this. can we do a 'best plant caption' micro-contest too? reactions as votes?
lia: yes please. i'll be remote but will share a pic of my office cactus named 'sprout'. :cactus:
anya: i'll drop a quick poll so we know how many people will pop in: /poll "Plant adopt + biscuit bake-off at 15:00?" "Yes" "No" "Maybe"
cheer-bot: Poll closed. Winner: Yes. Reminder: Plant adopt & biscuit bake-off tomorrow 15:00 local. Upload plant pic + biscuit photo to #random. Prize: plant sticker + digital cookie badge.
mike: posted recipe preview (not shown). caption: 'cardamom ambush'.
lia: uploaded sprout pic. caption: 'needs coffee, not water' :coffee::cactus:; sam: i'll upload a biscotti attempt. it's aggressively almond-y. :grimacing:
anya: Logistics note  office folks: leave plants by reception by 14:45 if you want them available for adoption, and label them with care notes.
cheer-bot: Event started: 15:00. Virtual hangout link pinned.
mike: live from kitchen with a thermos of spiced tea. also bringing a tiny handwritten care tag for the pothos.
sam: biscuit pic posted. caption: 'structurally ambitious'. :joy:
lia: voting via reactions now. :heart: = best plant caption, :star: = best biscuit, :tada: = people's choice.
cheer-bot: Event ended: 15:50. Winners: best plant caption = lia, best biscuit = mike, people's choice = sam. Congrats! :trophy:
